book.name: San Mateo
book.title: Dill' wen dill' kob daa bzej Matewa'

content: Jempl c̱he shi bi' nool wew'ka'
’Yeḻ' wṉabia' c̱he Chioza' chzaklebin daa gok c̱he shi bi' nool wew' wyaj to wishagna', na' bex̱'gakb' kandil c̱heb'ka' jḻezgakb' bi' byona' lill noola'.
Na' gay'gakb' nteyi na' zi gay'gakb' bi nteyi.
Bi'ka' bi nteyi konteḻe wza'len kandil c̱heb'ka', per bich bex̱'gakb' seta' yigaagakba'n.
Na' bi'ka' nteyi, bex̱'gakb' kandil c̱heb'ka' na' bex̱'tegakb' seta' yigaagakba'n.
Na' bi' wishagna'na' wlle'ib' na' bi' nool wew'ka' chbez gokxwesgakb' na' wtesgakb'.
Na' do ka chel besyaa to beṉ', chi'e: “¡Ba za' bi' wishagna'na', ḻi sho' lljatilchob'!”
Na' wyas bi' nool wew'ka' wzologakb' chiyonshao' kandil c̱heb'ka'.
Na' bi' nool wew'ka' bi nteyi gollgakb' bi'ka' zi gay': “Ḻi goṉgach neto' lat' set c̱helena' ḻa' ba chibill c̱hento'ni.”
Per bi'ka' nox̱' seta' che'gakb': “Bi goṉnto'n, kwenc̱he ki iyalljichon ganga. Wenlə ḻi shaj ḻi lljx̱i' c̱helena' gana' chiteen.”
Na' shlak zejgakb' zjx̱i'gakb' seta', bllin bi' wishagna'na' na' bi'ka' nox̱' seta' wyoolengakb' beṉ'ka' ḻoo yoona' gana' chak wishagna'na', na'ch wyej puerta'.
Na' ka billin bi' nool wew'ka' jx̱i' seta', wṉegakb' x̱an yoona' che'gakb': “¡Beṉ'do', bsaljgach shoonto'!”
Per x̱an yoona' chi'e ḻegakb': “Bi wsalj', ḻa' bi nombi'a le'.”
Na'ch che' Jesúza' beṉ'ka': ―Ka'kzə le', chiyaḻ' se kwasle, ḻa' aga ṉezile bi lla bi gor zizaa.
Jempl c̱he beṉ'ka' bgaaṉlen xmech x̱ane'ka'
’Yeḻ' wṉabia' c̱he Chioza' zaklebin dga wseesaa. To beṉ' wzee zeje' zit', na' ka ba zoa see, goxe' wen llin c̱he'ka' na' bene' lall' na'gake' xmeche'na' kwenc̱he gonlengake'n delgens.
’Na' toe' bi'e gayaa mil mech de or, na' stoe' c̱hopa milan, na' beena' sto bi'e to milan. Bi'e to toe' kon ka dii chakile' wak gonlengake' llinna'. Na'ch wzee zeje'.
Na' beena' bi'e gayaa milan, benlene'n llin na' bene' gan zi gayaa milan.
Na' ḻekzka' beena' bi'e c̱hopa milan, benlene'n llin na' bene' gan zi c̱hopa milan.
San beena' bi'e to milan, jtene' to yech na' bkwasheen.
’Na' ka ba gok ssha na' billin x̱ane'ka', na' goxe' to togake' kwenc̱he bidegake' kwent lawe'na'.
Na'ch zigaate beena' bi'e gayaa mil mech de or blline' lawe'na', chi'ene': “X̱an', ni de de gayaa mila' beṉo' nad', na' ni de zi gayaa mil daa benlena'n gan.”
Na' che' x̱ane'na'ne': “Ḻe wen beno', to wen llin wen inlleb nako', beno' ka chiyaḻ' gono' kon daa bkwaaṉlen' li' lat'. Na' dii xench goṉ' li' ṉaa. Wyoo kwenc̱he yibalenilo' nad'.”
Na'ch wdena' bllin wen llinna' bkwaaṉlene' c̱hopa mil, chi'ene': “X̱an', ni de de c̱hopa mila' beṉo' nad', na' ni de zi c̱hopa mil daa benlena'n gan.”
Na'ch che' x̱ane'na'ne': “Ḻe wen beno', to wen llin inlleb wen nako', beno' ka chiyaḻ' gono' kon daa bkwaaṉlen' li' lat'. Na' dii xench goṉ' li' ṉaa. Wyoo kwenc̱he yibalenilo' nad'.”
Per ka bllin wen llinna' bkwaaṉlene' to mil, na' golle' x̱ane'na': “X̱an', ṉezid' nako' beṉ' zṉia, na' to chizi'zo' banez daa chon beṉ' yoblə.
Na'chan blleb' gonditj' xmecho'na', daan wden' to yech na' bkwashaan. Ni de xmecho'na', bikaagachan, ḻa' c̱hekzo'n.”
Na'ch che' x̱ane'na'ne': “Beṉ' lia, bikz bi llin yejni'alallii chono'. Ṉezteilo' to chizi'z' banez daa chon beṉ' yoblə.
Na' daa ṉezilo' kan' chon', ¿berac̱he ki joo xmechaa gana' chon yic̱hjin shlak bi wzoa'? Sheḻ' beno' ka', na' ṉaa ba biyed' yiyoṉo'n lente yic̱hjinna', sheḻ'ka'.”
Na'ch golle' beṉ'ka' lle' na': “Ḻi yikaa mecha' daa bkwaaṉlene' na' ḻi we'n beena' nap shi milan.
Ḻa' kan' nakan, beena' chgone' llin daa yoo lo nee, gonche' lall' nee dii xench ax̱t gat' kwe'chile'; san beena' bi chgone' llin daa yoo lo nee, ax̱t daa ngoo lo nee lat' yidoyo.
Na' wen llinni bi yejni'alallii, ḻi wzaḻee gana' shgasj shc̱hoḻ, gana' kwellyeshee na' gaox̱ax̱j ḻeye'na' daa ḻe gakshejlallee.”
Ka gak kat' wc̱hoglo Jesúza' c̱he beṉ'
’Kat' ziza' nad', Beṉ' Bseḻ' Chioza' Yell-lioni, len balaaṉ xen c̱ha'na' na' yog' anjl c̱ha'ka', na' wli'a yeḻ' wṉabia' choo yeḻ' wṉabia' xen c̱ha'na'.
Na' yog' beṉ' lle' doxen yell-lioni yidopgake' lawa'na', na' gon' c̱he c̱heləgake' ka chon to beṉ' chape' bayix̱' chone' c̱helə xil'ka' na' c̱helə shibka'.
Na' wzoa' shḻaa de shḻi c̱ha'ni beṉ'ka' zaklebi xil'ka' daa chonḻilall'gake' nad', na' beṉ'ka' zaklebi shibka' daa bi benḻilall'gake' nad', wzoagakee shḻaa de robes c̱ha'ni.
Na' nad', beṉ' wṉabia', yep' beṉ'ka' lle' shḻaa de shḻi c̱ha'ni: “Ḻi da, ka le' ba ben X̱a' Chioza' ka gak wen c̱hele, na' si'le banez daa ba nonshawee c̱hele ka bx̱e bsiltie' yell-liona'.
Ḻa' ka wdon', bwaole nad'; na' ka wbiḻid', beṉle dii weej'; na' ka wda' ka beṉ' zit', bleble nad' lill-lena'.
Na' ka byallj xalaana', beṉle dii gokw', na' ka bi shawaa, bidwiale nad'; na' ka gotaa lillyana', bidwiale nad'.”
Na' yog' beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao'ka' iṉagake' nad': “X̱an', ¿batran ble'into' li' chdono' na' bwaonto' li'? ¿Batran ble'into' li' chbiḻilo' na' beṉnto' daa weejo'?
¿Batran ble'into' li' chdo' ka beṉ' zit' na' blebnto' li' ḻoo yoo lillnto'na'? ¿Batran ble'into' li' chdo' bibi xalaano' de na' beṉnto'n?
Na' ¿batran gokbe'into' bi shawoo wa gotoo lillyana' na' bidwianto' li'?”
Na' nad', beṉ' wṉabia', yepgakee: “Dii ḻi nia' le', yog' daa benle c̱he beṉ'ka' byallj bc̱hini, beṉ'ka' nak beṉ' bishaa na' beṉ' zan', ḻa'kzi bi nakgake' beṉ' zakii, nad'kzan benile ka'.”
’Na'ch yep' beṉ'ka' lle' shḻaa de robesi: “Ḻi kwas ka'lə, le' wen dii mal. Lo yi' gabiḻa' daa chaḻ' zejḻi kaṉi chidoḻ'le yiyajle gana' ba non Chioza' sak'zi' dii x̱iwaa len anjl c̱heyinka'.
Ḻa' ka wdon' bi beṉle dii gaw'; na' ka wbiḻid' bi beṉle dii yeej'.
Na' ka wda' ka beṉ' zit', aga bleble nad' ḻoo yoo lill-le. Na' ka byallj xalaana', aga bi beṉle; na' ka bi shawaa wa gotaa lillyana', aga bidwiale nad'.”
Na' iṉagake' nad': “X̱an', ¿batran wdono', wa wbiḻilo', wa wdoo ka beṉ' zit', wa bibi xalaano' got', wa bi shawoo, wa gotoo lillyana' na' bi goklennto' li'?”
Na' yepgakee: “Dii ḻi nia' le', daa bi goklenle beṉ'ka' byallj bc̱hini, beṉ'ka' nak beṉ' bishaa na' beṉ' zan', ḻa'kzi bi nakgake' beṉ' zakii, nad'kzan bi goklenle.”
Na' beṉ' malkan' yiyajgake' gana' tegake' yeḻ' sak'zi'na' zejḻi kaṉi, na' beṉ'ka' nak beṉ' ḻi beṉ' shao' soalengake' nad' zejḻi kaṉi.
